title: EXTN.OB------PART.
description: Chart on book p. 172 (EVOL-10). PART (participation) is the subject; the other title code, EXTN-OB (existential observation), is not drawn as a label, and the main line runs from the subject to PER-DY (perception dynamics). From the subject: INFO-DEBS, POL-DY (political dynamics) and AF-DT (affinity dictates). From INFO-DEBS: LG-DY (logical dynamics). From LG-DY: INTL (intellectualism), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From POL-DY: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From AF-DT: INFO-RT (information reality). From INFO-RT: PHY-U-FUND (physical universe fundamental) and TR (transformation). From TR: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation).
